project.art_direction: Retain the supplied master artwork's naturalistic detailed pixel art, coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters and restrained palette. No CGI or photographic noise.

project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: anubias_leaves
asset.description: Generate a PRODUCTION PART SHEET that faithfully preserves the exact supplied Anubias plant's drawing finish and dark green painted material. Exact 3 columns by 2 rows on pure white, NO grid lines, text or labels. In each equal cell draw ONE complete isolated Anubias barteri var. nana LEAF BLADE plus a short petiole stub, with clear white gaps around all leaves; petiole DOWN, leaf tip UP, blade fully inside its cell. Six unique leaves taken from the same plant: broad mature oval front-facing, medium broad slightly cupped, smaller young oval, mature blade gently curled to one side, angled broad leaf with folded shoulder, narrow freshly unfolding young leaf. Show the FULL continuous leaf contour including the basal shoulders and stem junction. The first five remain broad ovate leaves with full believable width, not generic lanceolate fern. Paint the exact leaf vein pattern, broad light/dark planes, rim and curled edge from the original. Avoid new coarse dithering or speckle texture. All leaves have their own curved silhouette. No whole plant, roots, rhizome, pot, scenery or overlap across cells. These six painted leaf images will be traced into individually shaped thick 3D leaves; no generic surface swatches. IMPORTANT: exact same individual Anubias barteri var. nana and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

plan.prompt:
Subject: Six unique Anubias barteri var. nana leaf blades from one plant: broad mature oval, cupped medium, small young, edge-curled, folded-shoulder angled, narrow unfolding young. Each leaf complete with basal shoulders and short petiole stub, petiole down, tip up.
Silhouette: Full continuous ovate contour per leaf, broad believable width — not lanceolate fern; each leaf its own curved silhouette, tips fully visible inside its cell.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Naturalistic detailed pixel-art painting matching the master: dark green restrained palette, broad light/dark planes, exact vein pattern, rim highlight, curled edge; no coarse dithering or speckle.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Orthographic flat leaf faces, petiole downward, tip upward.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; 3 columns by 2 rows of equal cells, no grid lines or labels, generous pure white #FFFFFF gaps and margin, no overlap, no ground or cast shadow.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No whole plant, roots, rhizome, pot, scenery, text, labels, grid lines, border, transparency, checkerboard, CGI or photographic noise.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
